data.name: Powerful Bond
data.description: As a free action, you can open a link to communicate telepathically with a single ally within 60 feet. The telepathic link is two-way and lasts for 1 minute. Unlike normal telepathy, this ability requires a shared language. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|DomainGoodTimes
